topic: Projectile Motion Variables and Air Resistance
key_concepts: Greater initial velocity increases time of flight, maximum height, and range.
Greater initial height increases maximum height, range, and landing time.
Initial velocity can be resolved into horizontal and vertical components using cosine and
Horizontal and vertical motion are analyzed with separate uniformly accelerated motion equ
Vertical motion uses acceleration due to gravity of -9.81 m/s².
Maximum height occurs at half the total flight time.
Air resistance reduces maximum height and range compared with ideal projectile motion.
Larger projectile diameter increases air resistance and shortens range and height.
Greater mass reduces deviation from ideal projectile path under air resistance.
At higher altitude, reduced air resistance slightly increases range and height.
